thread:
alex: kicking off a syncpoint for tomorrow's 03:00 UTC release window. need final compatibility signoff for api, runtime, console, router. deploy-bot will orchestrate.

miriam: @alex pushed master-rc3 earlier — runtime tests all green. one caveat: kernel-batching flag must be disabled for router path (it regresses p99).

sanjay: api has the schema shim in place, v2.1.4 is staged. no breaking changes. i'll pin traffic rules to allow both v2.1.3 and v2.1.4 during canary.

tara: console UI changes are behind a feature flag, safe to flip after runtime is live. will hold the visual-rollout to 5% until metrics look steady.

alex: good. concrete checklist: 1) deploy-bot starts at 03:00 UTC; 2) runtime deploy (master-rc3) with kernel-batching=false; 3) router update next; 4) api switch to v2.1.4 canary 5%; 5) console feature flag 5%. rollback criteria below.

deploy-bot: confirmed. planned command:
```
/deploy start --window=03:00-04:00 --order=runtime,router,api,console --id=rel-4791013
```

miriam: note — kernel-batching flag toggle: ``systemctl set-flag kernel-batching=false`` then warm caches for 10m. i'll run the warmup job.

sanjay: rollback plan for api: if 5xx rate >0.5% for 3m OR error spike above baseline by 3x, route back to v2.1.3 and disable schema-shim. rollback command: ``/deploy rollback api --to v2.1.3 --tag rel-4791013``

tara: console rollback: flip feature flag off, purge local caches, revert frontend bundle to 2026-03-18 build. will keep screenshots in the runbook.

alex: runtime-router interop test to run post-deploy: send 1k requests across 3 seq lengths (8/128/512), assert p50/p95/p99 within thresholds. thresholds: p99 < 400ms, error rate < 0.1%.

release-bot: automated checks queued: canary traffic ramp schedule: 5% @ +10m, 25% @ +25m, 100% @ +40m. health gates: p99, 5xx, token-drop.

miriam: i'll watch the warmup logs and post the boot logs in the channel. quick command to tail: ``kubectl logs -l app=runtime -f --since=10m``

sanjay: tagging release notes now, linking doc: https://redwood.intranet/releases/rel-4791013 (draft). adding schema diff and rollback steps.

alex: final ask — ops team please confirm router team has compatibility patch for header-splitting (router v3.2.1). @tara @miriam please ack once ready.

tara: ack, console safe. i'll hold 5% until green. :thumbsup:

miriam: ack, runtime ready. will post warmup complete and kernel-batching toggle proof. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: scheduled and will post heartbeat messages during the window. will stop on manual abort or on health gate failure.

alex: perfect. i'll update the release notes with the final runbook and rollback commands, then pin this thread for the window. thanks team.
